# DepthFill

Namespace `Nfty.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Model`.

```csharp
public static class DepthFill
```

Fill-all: the one action that replaced the old Front / Symmetric / Raised modes. It sets every solid pixel of a picture to the same (front, back) at once.

## Methods

### All(Image&lt;Rgba32&gt;, byte, byte) { #m-all-sixlabors-imagesharp-image-sixlabors-imagesharp-pi-1debf6 }

```csharp
public static DepthMap All(Image<Rgba32> art, byte front, byte back);
```

A depth map giving every solid pixel of `art` the same depth.

**Parameters**

- `art` (`Image<Rgba32>`) - The picture. Solid means [`Opacity.IsSolid()`](../nfty-core/Nfty.Core.Imaging.Opacity.md#m-issolid-sixlabors-imagesharp-pixelformats-rgba32).
- `front` (`byte`) - Voxels toward the viewer, 0..255.
- `back` (`byte`) - Voxels away from the viewer, 0..255.

**Returns.** A map the size of the art: (front, back) on every solid pixel, zero elsewhere. It REPLACES any stored map — fill-all touches every solid pixel, so nothing of the old one survives it — which is why this takes none.
